content.short: EigenLayer is Ethereum's restaking protocol allowing validators to extend Ethereum's cryptoeconomic security to additional protocols called AVSs.
content.description: EigenLayer is a restaking protocol on Ethereum founded by Sreeram Kannan that allows validators to opt-in to securing additional networks and services  called Actively Validated Services (AVSs)  beyond Ethereum itself using their staked ETH. This extends Ethereum's trust and security to new protocols without requiring them to bootstrap their own validator set. EigenLayer raised $100M and has attracted billions in restaked TVL since its launch. Its integration with Mantle enables users to access restaking opportunities and earn additional yield on staked assets.
content.meta: EigenLayer enables ETH restaking to extend cryptoeconomic security to multiple protocols from Mantle. Discover EigenLayer on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
